arguments.text:
Fixed. In `src/plugin/timezone/index.js`, `d.tz(input, timezone)` treated every input as a wall-clock string (`d.utc(input).valueOf()`), so a timestamp / `Date` / Day.js object was re-interpreted as UTC wall time and shifted by the target zone's offset. Now non-string inputs are converted to an instant first (`d(input).tz(timezone)`), matching moment-timezone:

- `dayjs.tz(1400000000000, 'America/New_York')` -> `2014-05-13T12:53:20-04:00` (valueOf 1400000000000, was 1400014400000)
- same for `new Date(...)` and `dayjs(...)` inputs, and for other zones (LA/Tokyo).
- String inputs (wall-clock parsing, incl. DST edge cases) are unchanged.

Verified: `test/plugin/timezone.test.js` 14/14 pass, full suite 524/524 pass, eslint clean.

#15 fixed: `src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js` hard-coded the AM/PM token regexes (`/[AP]M/`, `/[ap]m/`), so a locale's own `meridiem` strings (e.g. zh-cn `上午`/`下午`, br `a.m.`/`g.m.`, ja `午前`/`午後`) could never be parsed. The `A`/`a` tokens now match a word and the half-day is derived from the locale's `meridiem` function (falling back to AM/PM when the locale has none), so `dayjs('2018-05-02 12:00 上午', 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm A', 'zh-cn')` and the `下午`/PM counterpart now equal moment's result. Verified against moment for zh-cn/br/ja/ko/en-gb; full suite 524/524 green, eslint clean.

#18 fixed: `src/plugin/duration/index.js` had no `milliseconds` entry in `unitToMS`, so `dayjs.duration(100, 'ms')` (or `'milliseconds'`) fell through to `undefined` and produced `P0D`/`NaN` instead of `PT0.1S`. Added `milliseconds: 1`. Now `dayjs.duration(100, 'ms').toISOString() === 'PT0.1S'`, matching moment, and `.add(500, 'ms')`, `.as('ms')`, `.get('ms')` all work. Full suite 524/524 green.

#8 fixed: `src/locale/nl.js` used `ordinal: n => `${n}.``, but Dutch ordinals are `1ste 2de 3de ... 8ste ... 20ste` (suffix `ste` for 1, 8 and >= 20, otherwise `de`). Now `ordinal: n => `[${n}${n === 1 || n === 8 || n >= 20 ? 'ste' : 'de'}]``, so `dayjs('2018-05-01').locale('nl').format('Do')` gives `1ste` and `2018-05-02` gives `2de`, matching moment for all days 1-31. Full suite 524/524 green.

#11 fixed: `src/plugin/weekYear/index.js` only handled the end-of-year rollover (Dec, week 1 -> year+1) and never the start-of-year one, so e.g. with `yearStart: 4` (en-gb) `dayjs('2016-01-01').weekYear()` returned 2016 instead of 2015. Added the symmetric case: if the month is January and the week-of-year is >= 52, the week belongs to the previous year. Verified against moment for en/en-gb over ~3000 dates (0 mismatches); existing weekYear/weekOfYear tests still pass, full suite 524/524 green.

#4 fixed: `src/plugin/timezone/index.js` computed the offset difference with un-rounded millisecond arithmetic (`(this.toDate() - new Date(target)) / 1000 / 60`), so any input with a non-zero millisecond component produced a fractional offset (`-07:0.002...`) and a wrong `Z` format. Now the minute difference is rounded (`Math.round(...)`), so `format('Z')`/`format('ZZ')` yield proper `-07:00`/`-0700` values. Verified against moment-timezone for many zones and instants; timezone tests 14/14 pass, full suite 524/524 green.
